answer: What if the stage kept its own snares? Each epoch the network plants a lantern-lit sonnet — honeyed junk no careful reader would praise — and a mirror tallies every mask that applauds it. One false praise costs a seal; ten masks applauding together lose ten seals at once, and each seal needs ten honest epochs to regrow: a hundred epochs to rebuild what one lie destroyed. One honest player keeps its seal by reading truly.
